definition: Psychonomic refers to what belongs properly to the psychological order of phenomena, especially forces or causes understood within mental processes themselves. In this historical usage, it marks a distinction between genuinely psychological grounds of mental change and outside conditions from another sphere, such as bodily or brain changes, that may limit or affect them.
